experiment: One all-legal-action coverage repair after verified shortlist objective failure
scope: Classic Normal only; additive desktop ranking model preserving the production correction and cooperation guard. No X16 compression or production promotion in this trial.
data: Same retained full-history roots and original training267/previousheldout53 split. The previous heldout has informed this repair and is development evidence only. Fresh tournament seeds are the strength test.

learner.objective: All unordered legal-action pairs with nontrivial teacher margin, excluding pairs where neither correction is permitted; equal total pair weight per root. Same fixed features, capacity and hyperparameters as v1.
learner.tuning: One fixed fit, no held-out hyperparameter selection or refitting after tournaments. Production is the zero-delta baseline.

offline_gate: Training all-action mean teacher score regret must improve over production; old heldout reported as development only, no independent generalization claim. Frozen inference must pass.

tournament.primary: Fresh matched candidate-minus-production league score,95% complete-opponent-and-side block bootstrap. Lower bound>0 supports improvement for tested distribution; crossing0 is inconclusive. Old heldout cannot establish generalization for this repair.
tournament.secondary: Direct production head-to-head; no requirement to defeat the teacher. Fixed cohort, no extension after inspecting outcomes.
tournament.time_cap: If diagnostics or runtime consume the budget, stop at a recorded partial stage. Never silently reduce the fixed cohort and call it full validation.

reason: The v1 surrogate omitted alternatives that remained eligible at runtime. Independent frozen C audit confirms this modeling flaw, not an exporter bug. This explicitly supersedes original one-fit limit for one documented repair; no more fits after this repair.
